    Modules

    MedEx.Capture

    GenServer that writes indexed mono 48 kHz PCM16LE audio to an immutable, content-addressed WAV file and fans full frames out to a bounded live Opus preview branch.

    MedEx.Evidence

    Finalized evidence returned by MedEx.Capture.finish/1 for a continuous mono 48 kHz PCM16LE WAV acquisition.

    MedEx.Preview

    One replaceable, send-only WebRTC peer for an Opus preview. The caller owns the peer and receives its ExWebRTC state changes. Capture has its own lifetime.

    MedEx.Web

    Locates MedEx's packaged browser JavaScript assets.
